note: one boot per arm; every run in it is one capstone-vexec process at this arm's PHP_CAP_MODE. The trigger files are the corpus's own, staged verbatim

scoring.attribution: declared function (case.json fault_sites) in its file, with a protective cause (arms.json protective_causes)
scoring.gate: default: a case whose pristine record is a SIGNAL reads out-of-denominator on every arm, whatever the arm did -- the unprotected program dies anyway, so there is no pair to read
